title: Review P2
summary: An independent read-only review checks P2.1–P2.14 against the reference (knowledge/contracts, type-map, architecture#scope-boundary, #extension-system, #operation-chains G, p2-execution) and D15–D17, and records a GREEN or RED verdict with findings in artifacts/reviews/P2-review.md.
why: Owner requested a review of P2 (brief M14). P2 rewrites the whole extension surface, the scope eligibility and SQL paths and the transactional journal; a fresh reader catches silent signature drift, weakened tests, approximate visibility and participant bypasses that item-level checks can miss.

include: Signature conformance: every new/changed supported type and member vs knowledge/contracts (manifest diff against the reference)
Placement/marker conformance vs the oracle; no shims or aliases (D16); interim placement per D17
Scope paths: check order and failure mapping (p2-execution#scope-order) in boundary, authority, batch, validator, directories, visibility; parity matrix unchanged except the 82 directory verdicts
Participant model: enforcement points, bypass routes, interfering pairs (p2-execution#participant-model) with test evidence on all drivers
Tests: no weakened, skipped or deleted assertions (git diff of tests since the P2 start commit); every new rule has a negative test
Migration instruction completeness and brevity; allowlists owner-P3 only
Verdict, findings table {id, item, file:line, rule, severity, fix}, and re-run of P2.14 acceptance commands
exclude: Changing code or fixtures (read-only; fixes go through reopened items)

reads.why: Rules every P2 item follows (reference wins, no shims, D17 placement, attributes, snapshots, migration lines)
Shared check order, envelope and failure mapping for every scope path
Transaction invariant, enforcement points, bypass routes and interfering pairs
Owners/roots, Internal placement rule, stable FQCNs, composition roots — where new files go
Report-mode allowlist protocol and which entries this item removes
Exact validation commands and driver environment
Review method and change log conventions of revision 2
Format and depth of a previous review record (findings with file:line, verdict)

rules: A finding needs a file:line and the violated reference rule; style preferences are not findings.

validation.cmd: git diff --quiet HEAD -- packages tests bin docs
validation.expect: exit 0 (review changed nothing outside the plan)
